info.name: FidduPay Complete API v2.5.6
info.description: Complete API collection for FidduPay cryptocurrency payment gateway. Supports 10 cryptocurrencies across 5 major blockchains with enterprise-grade security and comprehensive admin functionality.

request.description: Scans the blockchain for the given address and reconciles the database balance. Works for BSC, ETH, SOL, etc.
Returns aggregate statistics (total, active, flagged, recent) and total aggregate balance in USD for all platform customers.
Sweeps ALL locked assets from the customer sub-wallet to your Master Wallet. Gas fees are automatically deducted from your native ledger balance.
Sweep a specific asset from the customer sub-wallet.
Sweep only stablecoin balances to your Master Wallet.
Scans ALL customers linked to your merchant account and auto-provisions missing wallets.
Resolves an on-chain address back to the owning customer.
Full snapshot of all customer active vs historical wallets.
